data.page_content:
Blueberry Scones

A delightful, buttery scone recipe with fresh blueberries.

Ingredients

  • 2 cups all-purpose flour
  • 1/3 cup granulated sugar
  • 1 tbsp baking powder
  • 1/2 tsp salt
  • 1/2 cup unsalted butter, cold
  • 3/4 cup heavy cream
  • 1 large egg
  • 1 tsp vanilla extract
  • 1 cup fresh blueberries

Instructions

  1. Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C).
  2. Mix dry ingredients in a large bowl.
  3. Cut cold butter into small pieces and mix into dry ingredients until crumbly.
  4. In a separate bowl, whisk together cream, egg, and vanilla.
  5. Combine wet and dry ingredients, fold in blueberries gently.
  6. Shape into a circle on a baking sheet, cut into wedges.
  7. Bake for 15-18 minutes until golden brown.

Enjoy warm with clotted cream or jam!

data.content:
Blueberry Scones Recipe

Ingredients

  • 2 cups all-purpose flour
  • 1/4 cup granulated sugar
  • 1 tablespoon baking powder
  • 1/2 teaspoon salt
  • 6 tablespoons cold unsalted butter, cubed
  • 1 cup fresh blueberries
  • 1 large egg
  • 1/2 cup heavy cream
  • 1 teaspoon vanilla extract

Instructions

  1. Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C) and line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
  2. In a large bowl, whisk together flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt.
  3. Cut in the cold butter until mixture resembles coarse crumbs.
  4. Gently fold in blueberries.
  5. In another bowl, whisk egg, heavy cream, and vanilla. Stir into dry ingredients until just combined.
  6. Turn dough onto floured surface, shape into an 8-inch circle, and cut into 8 wedges.
  7. Place wedges on baking sheet and bake for 15-18 minutes until golden brown.
  8. Cool on wire rack before serving.

Prep Time: 15 minutes | Cook Time: 18 minutes | Servings: 8

  • 1 large egg
  • 1 tsp vanilla extract

  2. In a large bowl, whisk together flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt.
  3. Cut in the cold butter using a pastry cutter or fork until the mixture resembles coarse crumbs.
  4. Gently fold in blueberries.
  5. In a separate bowl, whisk together cream, egg, and vanilla.

  7. Turn the dough onto a floured surface, shape into an 8-inch circle, and cut into 8 wedges.
  8. Place wedges on the baking sheet and bake for 18-20 minutes until golden brown.
  9. Cool slightly before serving.

data.content:
Blueberry Scones Recipe

Ingredients

  • 2 cups all-purpose flour
  • 1/4 cup granulated sugar
  • 1 tablespoon baking powder
  • 1/2 teaspoon salt
  • 6 tablespoons cold unsalted butter, cubed
  • 1 cup fresh blueberries
  • 1 large egg
  • 1/2 cup heavy cream
  • 1 teaspoon vanilla extract

Instructions

  1. Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C) and line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
  2. In a large bowl, whisk together flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt.
  3. Cut in the cold butter until mixture resembles coarse crumbs.
  4. Gently fold in blueberries.
  5. In another bowl, whisk egg, heavy cream, and vanilla. Stir into dry ingredients until just combined.
  6. Turn dough onto floured surface, shape into an 8-inch circle, and cut into 8 wedges.
  7. Place wedges on baking sheet and bake for 15-18 minutes until golden brown.
  8. Cool on wire rack before serving.

Prep Time: 15 minutes | Cook Time: 18 minutes | Servings: 8

Home | Recipes | About

Prep Time: 15 minutes | Cook Time: 20 minutes | Total Time: 35 minutes

Servings: 8 scones

Ingredients

  • 2 cups all-purpose flour
  • 1/4 cup granulated sugar
  • 1 tbsp baking powder
  • 1/2 tsp salt
  • 6 tbsp cold unsalted butter, cubed
  • 1/2 cup fresh blueberries
  • 1/2 cup heavy cream
  • 1 large egg
  • 1 tsp vanilla extract

Instructions

  1. Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
  2. In a large bowl, whisk together flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt.
  3. Cut in the cold butter using a pastry cutter or fork until the mixture resembles coarse crumbs.
  4. Gently fold in blueberries.
  5. In a separate bowl, whisk together cream, egg, and vanilla.
  6. Pour the wet ingredients into the dry ingredients and stir until just combined.
  7. Turn the dough onto a floured surface, shape into an 8-inch circle, and cut into 8 wedges.
  8. Place wedges on the baking sheet and bake for 18-20 minutes until golden brown.
  9. Cool slightly before serving.

Tips & Notes

  • 1/2 cup heavy cream
  • 1 teaspoon vanilla extract

  1. Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C) and line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
  2. In a large bowl, whisk together flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt.
  3. Cut in the cold butter until mixture resembles coarse crumbs.
  4. Gently fold in blueberries.
  5. In another bowl, whisk egg, heavy cream, and vanilla. Stir into dry ingredients until just combined.
  6. Turn dough onto floured surface, shape into an 8-inch circle, and cut into 8 wedges.
  7. Place wedges on baking sheet and bake for 15-18 minutes until golden brown.
  8. Cool on wire rack before serving.

data.title: Blueberry Scones Recipe | Coded Culinary
data.html_content:
Blueberry Scones

Home | Recipes | About

Ingredients

  • 2 cups all-purpose flour
  • 1/3 cup granulated sugar
  • 1 tbsp baking powder
  • 1/2 tsp salt
  • 6 tbsp cold unsalted butter, cubed
  • 1 cup fresh or frozen blueberries
  • 1/2 cup heavy cream
  • 1 large egg
  • 1 tsp vanilla extract
  • Optional: coarse sugar for sprinkling

Instructions

  1. Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
  2. In a large bowl, whisk together flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt.
  3. Cut in the cold butter using a pastry cutter or fingers until mixture resembles coarse crumbs.
  4. Gently fold in blueberries.
  5. In a separate bowl, whisk together cream, egg, and vanilla.
  6. Pour wet ingredients into dry ingredients and stir until just combined.
  7. Turn dough onto a floured surface, shape into a 1-inch thick circle, and cut into 8 wedges.
  8. Place wedges on the prepared baking sheet, brush with extra cream, and sprinkle with coarse sugar if desired.
  9. Bake for 18-22 minutes until golden brown. Cool on a wire rack before serving.

Tips

For best results, use cold ingredients and handle the dough minimally to keep scones tender. Serve warm with clotted cream or jam.

© 2026 Coded Culinary. Recipe last updated: 2025-11-15.

data.title: Blueberry Scones Recipe | Coded Culinary
data.html_content:
Blueberry Scones

Home | Recipes | About

Ingredients

  • 2 cups all-purpose flour
  • 1/3 cup granulated sugar
  • 1 tbsp baking powder
  • 1/2 tsp salt
  • 6 tbsp cold unsalted butter, cubed
  • 1 cup fresh or frozen blueberries
  • 1/2 cup heavy cream
  • 1 large egg
  • 1 tsp vanilla extract
  • Optional: coarse sugar for sprinkling

Instructions

  1. Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
  2. In a large bowl, whisk together flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt.
  3. Cut in the cold butter using a pastry cutter or fingers until mixture resembles coarse crumbs.
  4. Gently fold in blueberries.
  5. In a separate bowl, whisk together cream, egg, and vanilla.
  6. Pour wet ingredients into dry ingredients and stir until just combined.
  7. Turn dough onto a floured surface, shape into a 1-inch thick circle, and cut into 8 wedges.
  8. Place wedges on the prepared baking sheet, brush with extra cream, and sprinkle with coarse sugar if desired.
  9. Bake for 18-22 minutes until golden brown. Cool on a wire rack before serving.

Tips

For best results, use cold ingredients and handle the dough minimally to keep scones tender. Serve warm with clotted cream or jam.

© 2026 Coded Culinary. Recipe last updated: 2025-11-15.

data.content:
Blueberry Scones Recipe

Ingredients

  • 2 cups all-purpose flour
  • 1/4 cup granulated sugar
  • 1 tablespoon baking powder
  • 1/2 teaspoon salt
  • 6 tablespoons cold unsalted butter, cubed
  • 1 cup fresh blueberries
  • 1 large egg
  • 1/2 cup heavy cream
  • 1 teaspoon vanilla extract

Instructions

  1. Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C) and line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
  2. In a large bowl, whisk together flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt.
  3. Cut in the cold butter until mixture resembles coarse crumbs.
  4. Gently fold in blueberries.
  5. In another bowl, whisk egg, heavy cream, and vanilla. Stir into dry ingredients until just combined.
  6. Turn dough onto floured surface, shape into an 8-inch circle, and cut into 8 wedges.
  7. Place wedges on baking sheet and bake for 15-18 minutes until golden brown.
  8. Cool on wire rack before serving.

Prep Time: 15 minutes | Cook Time: 18 minutes | Servings: 8

data.title: Blueberry Scones Recipe | Coded Culinary
data.html_content:
Blueberry Scones

Home | Recipes | About

Ingredients

  • 2 cups all-purpose flour
  • 1/3 cup granulated sugar
  • 1 tbsp baking powder
  • 1/2 tsp salt
  • 6 tbsp cold unsalted butter, cubed
  • 1 cup fresh or frozen blueberries
  • 1/2 cup heavy cream
  • 1 large egg
  • 1 tsp vanilla extract
  • Optional: coarse sugar for sprinkling

Instructions

  1. Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
  2. In a large bowl, whisk together flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt.
  3. Cut in the cold butter using a pastry cutter or fingers until mixture resembles coarse crumbs.
  4. Gently fold in blueberries.
  5. In a separate bowl, whisk together cream, egg, and vanilla.
  6. Pour wet ingredients into dry ingredients and stir until just combined.
  7. Turn dough onto a floured surface, shape into a 1-inch thick circle, and cut into 8 wedges.
  8. Place wedges on the prepared baking sheet, brush with extra cream, and sprinkle with coarse sugar if desired.
  9. Bake for 18-22 minutes until golden brown. Cool on a wire rack before serving.

Tips

For best results, use cold ingredients and handle the dough minimally to keep scones tender. Serve warm with clotted cream or jam.

© 2026 Coded Culinary. Recipe last updated: 2025-11-15.

data.content_preview:
Blueberry Scones Recipe

Delicious, flaky scones filled with juicy blueberries. Perfect for breakfast or tea time.

Ingredients

  • 2 cups all-purpose flour
  • 1/4 cup granulated sugar
  • 1 tbsp baking powder
  • 1/2 tsp salt
  • 1/2 cup unsalted butter, cold and cubed
  • 1/2 cup heavy cream
  • 1 large egg
  • 1 tsp vanilla extract
  • 1 cup fresh blueberries

Instructions

  1. Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
  2. In a large bowl, whisk together flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt.
  3. Cut in the cold butter until the mixture resembles coarse crumbs.
  4. In a separate bowl, whisk together cream, egg, and vanilla.
  5. Gradually add the wet ingredients to the dry, mixing until just combined.
  6. Gently fold in blueberries.
  7. Turn dough onto a floured surface, shape into a 1-inch thick circle, and cut into 8 wedges.
  8. Place wedges on the prepared baking sheet and bake for 15-18 minutes until golden brown.
  9. Cool slightly before serving.

  • 1 tsp vanilla extract

  7. Turn dough onto a floured surface, shape into an 8-inch circle, and cut into 8 wedges.
  8. Place wedges on prepared baking sheet and bake for 15-18 minutes until golden brown.
  9. Cool on a wire rack before serving.

Yields 8 scones. Store in an airtight container for up to 3 days.

result.content:
Blueberry Scones Recipe

Ingredients

  • 2 cups all-purpose flour
  • 1/4 cup granulated sugar
  • 1 tablespoon baking powder
  • 1/2 teaspoon salt
  • 6 tablespoons cold unsalted butter, cubed
  • 1 cup fresh blueberries
  • 1 large egg
  • 1/2 cup heavy cream
  • 1 teaspoon vanilla extract

Instructions

  1. Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C) and line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
  2. In a large bowl, whisk together flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt.
  3. Cut in the cold butter until mixture resembles coarse crumbs.
  4. Gently fold in blueberries.
  5. In another bowl, whisk egg, heavy cream, and vanilla. Stir into dry ingredients until just combined.
  6. Turn dough onto floured surface, shape into an 8-inch circle, and cut into 8 wedges.
  7. Place wedges on baking sheet and bake for 15-18 minutes until golden brown.
  8. Cool on wire rack before serving.

Prep Time: 15 minutes | Cook Time: 18 minutes | Servings: 8

data.content_preview:
Blueberry Scones Recipe

Delicious, flaky scones filled with juicy blueberries. Perfect for breakfast or tea time.

Ingredients

  • 2 cups all-purpose flour
  • 1/4 cup granulated sugar
  • 1 tbsp baking powder
  • 1/2 tsp salt
  • 1/2 cup unsalted butter, cold and cubed
  • 1/2 cup heavy cream
  • 1 large egg
  • 1 tsp vanilla extract
  • 1 cup fresh blueberries

Instructions

  1. Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
  2. In a large bowl, whisk together flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt.
  3. Cut in the cold butter until the mixture resembles coarse crumbs.
  4. In a separate bowl, whisk together cream, egg, and vanilla.
  5. Gradually add the wet ingredients to the dry, mixing until just combined.
  6. Gently fold in blueberries.
  7. Turn dough onto a floured surface, shape into a 1-inch thick circle, and cut into 8 wedges.
  8. Place wedges on the prepared baking sheet and bake for 15-18 minutes until golden brown.
  9. Cool slightly before serving.

data.pageTitle: Classic Blueberry Scones Recipe | Coded Culinary
data.pageContent:
Welcome to Coded Culinary's recipe for Classic Blueberry Scones. This recipe yields 8 tender, flaky scones with bursts of juicy blueberries. Prep time: 15 minutes | Cook time: 18-22 minutes | Total: 33-37 minutes.

Ingredients:
- 2 cups all-purpose flour
- 1/3 cup granulated sugar
- 1 tbsp baking powder
- 1/2 tsp salt
- 1/2 cup cold unsalted butter, cubed
- 1 cup fresh blueberries
- 2/3 cup cold heavy cream
- 1 large egg
- 1 tsp vanilla extract

Instructions:
1. Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C) and line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
2. In a large bowl, whisk together flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt.
3. Cut in cold butter using a pastry cutter until mixture resembles coarse crumbs.
4. Gently fold in blueberries.
5. In a separate bowl, whisk together cream, egg, and vanilla.
6. Add wet ingredients to dry, stirring just until combined.
7. Turn dough onto a floured surface, shape into an 8-inch circle, and cut into 8 wedges.
8. Place wedges on prepared sheet, brush with cream, and sprinkle with coarse sugar.
9. Bake for 18-22 minutes until golden brown.

Tips: For best results, keep ingredients cold and avoid overmixing. Serve warm with clotted cream or lemon curd.

data.pageContent:
Welcome to Coded Culinary's recipe for Classic Blueberry Scones. This recipe yields 8 tender, flaky scones with bursts of juicy blueberries. Prep time: 15 minutes | Cook time: 18-22 minutes | Total: 33-37 minutes.

Ingredients:
- 2 cups all-purpose flour
- 1/3 cup granulated sugar
- 1 tbsp baking powder
- 1/2 tsp salt
- 1/2 cup cold unsalted butter, cubed
- 1 cup fresh blueberries
- 2/3 cup cold heavy cream
- 1 large egg
- 1 tsp vanilla extract

Instructions:
1. Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C) and line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
2. In a large bowl, whisk together flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt.
3. Cut in cold butter using a pastry cutter until mixture resembles coarse crumbs.
4. Gently fold in blueberries.
5. In a separate bowl, whisk together cream, egg, and vanilla.
6. Add wet ingredients to dry, stirring just until combined.
7. Turn dough onto a floured surface, shape into an 8-inch circle, and cut into 8 wedges.
8. Place wedges on prepared sheet, brush with cream, and sprinkle with coarse sugar.
9. Bake for 18-22 minutes until golden brown.

Tips: For best results, keep ingredients cold and avoid overmixing. Serve warm with clotted cream or lemon curd.

data.content:
Blueberry Scones Recipe

Ingredients

  • 2 cups all-purpose flour
  • 1/4 cup granulated sugar
  • 1 tablespoon baking powder
  • 1/2 teaspoon salt
  • 6 tablespoons cold unsalted butter, cubed
  • 1 cup fresh blueberries
  • 1 large egg
  • 1/2 cup heavy cream
  • 1 teaspoon vanilla extract

Instructions

  1. Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C) and line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
  2. In a large bowl, whisk together flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt.
  3. Cut in the cold butter until mixture resembles coarse crumbs.
  4. Gently fold in blueberries.
  5. In another bowl, whisk egg, heavy cream, and vanilla. Stir into dry ingredients until just combined.
  6. Turn dough onto floured surface, shape into an 8-inch circle, and cut into 8 wedges.
  7. Place wedges on baking sheet and bake for 15-18 minutes until golden brown.
  8. Cool on wire rack before serving.

Prep Time: 15 minutes | Cook Time: 18 minutes | Servings: 8

data.title: Blueberry Scones Recipe - CodedCulinary
data.content:
Perfect Blueberry Scones

A delicious, tender scone bursting with fresh blueberries. Perfect for breakfast or afternoon tea.

Ingredients

  • 2 cups all-purpose flour
  • 1/3 cup granulated sugar
  • 1 tablespoon baking powder
  • 1/2 teaspoon salt
  • 1/2 cup cold unsalted butter, cubed
  • 1 cup fresh blueberries
  • 1/2 cup heavy cream
  • 1 large egg
  • 1 teaspoon vanilla extract

Instructions

  1. Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
  2. In a large bowl, whisk together flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt.
  3. Cut in the cold butter until mixture resembles coarse crumbs.
  4. Gently fold in blueberries.
  5. In a separate bowl, whisk together cream, egg, and vanilla.
  6. Add wet ingredients to dry ingredients, stirring just until combined.
  7. Turn dough onto a floured surface and pat into a 1-inch thick circle.
  8. Cut into 8 wedges and place on prepared baking sheet.
  9. Bake for 18-22 minutes until golden brown.
  10. Cool slightly before serving.

Yield: 8 scones

Preparation time: 15 minutes

Baking time: 20 minutes

data.title: Blueberry Scones Recipe | Coded Culinary
data.html_content:
Blueberry Scones

Home | Recipes | About

Ingredients

  • 2 cups all-purpose flour
  • 1/3 cup granulated sugar
  • 1 tbsp baking powder
  • 1/2 tsp salt
  • 6 tbsp cold unsalted butter, cubed
  • 1 cup fresh or frozen blueberries
  • 1/2 cup heavy cream
  • 1 large egg
  • 1 tsp vanilla extract
  • Optional: coarse sugar for sprinkling

Instructions

  1. Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
  2. In a large bowl, whisk together flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt.
  3. Cut in the cold butter using a pastry cutter or fingers until mixture resembles coarse crumbs.
  4. Gently fold in blueberries.
  5. In a separate bowl, whisk together cream, egg, and vanilla.
  6. Pour wet ingredients into dry ingredients and stir until just combined.
  7. Turn dough onto a floured surface, shape into a 1-inch thick circle, and cut into 8 wedges.
  8. Place wedges on the prepared baking sheet, brush with extra cream, and sprinkle with coarse sugar if desired.
  9. Bake for 18-22 minutes until golden brown. Cool on a wire rack before serving.

Tips

For best results, use cold ingredients and handle the dough minimally to keep scones tender. Serve warm with clotted cream or jam.

data.page_content:
Blueberry Scones

A delightful, buttery scone recipe with fresh blueberries.

Ingredients

  • 2 cups all-purpose flour
  • 1/3 cup granulated sugar
  • 1 tbsp baking powder
  • 1/2 tsp salt
  • 1/2 cup unsalted butter, cold
  • 3/4 cup heavy cream
  • 1 large egg
  • 1 tsp vanilla extract
  • 1 cup fresh blueberries

Instructions

  1. Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C).
  2. Mix dry ingredients in a large bowl.
  3. Cut cold butter into small pieces and mix into dry ingredients until crumbly.
  4. In a separate bowl, whisk together cream, egg, and vanilla.
  5. Combine wet and dry ingredients, fold in blueberries gently.
  6. Shape into a circle on a baking sheet, cut into wedges.
  7. Bake for 15-18 minutes until golden brown.

Enjoy warm with clotted cream or jam!

data.content:
Blueberry Scones Recipe

Ingredients

  • 2 cups all-purpose flour
  • 1/4 cup granulated sugar
  • 1 tablespoon baking powder
  • 1/2 teaspoon salt
  • 6 tablespoons cold unsalted butter, cubed
  • 1 cup fresh blueberries
  • 1 large egg
  • 1/2 cup heavy cream
  • 1 teaspoon vanilla extract

Instructions

  1. Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C) and line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
  2. In a large bowl, whisk together flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt.
  3. Cut in the cold butter until mixture resembles coarse crumbs.
  4. Gently fold in blueberries.
  5. In another bowl, whisk egg, heavy cream, and vanilla. Stir into dry ingredients until just combined.
  6. Turn dough onto floured surface, shape into an 8-inch circle, and cut into 8 wedges.
  7. Place wedges on baking sheet and bake for 15-18 minutes until golden brown.
  8. Cool on wire rack before serving.

Prep Time: 15 minutes | Cook Time: 18 minutes | Servings: 8

  2. In a large bowl, whisk together flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt.
  3. Cut in the cold butter using a pastry cutter or fingers until mixture resembles coarse crumbs.
  4. Gently fold in blueberries.
  5. In a separate bowl, whisk together cream, egg, and vanilla.
  6. Pour wet ingredients into dry ingredients and stir until just combined.
  7. Turn dough onto a floured surface, shape into a 1-inch thick circle, and cut into 8 wedges.
  8. Place wedges on the prepared baking sheet, brush with extra cream, and sprinkle with coarse sugar if desired.
  9. Bake for 18-22 minutes until golden brown. Cool on a wire rack before serving.

Tips

For best results, use cold ingredients and handle the dough minimally to keep scones tender. Serve warm with clotted cream or jam.

data.title: Blueberry Scones Recipe | Coded Culinary
data.html_content:
Blueberry Scones

Home | Recipes | About

Ingredients

  • 2 cups all-purpose flour
  • 1/3 cup granulated sugar
  • 1 tbsp baking powder
  • 1/2 tsp salt
  • 6 tbsp cold unsalted butter, cubed
  • 1 cup fresh or frozen blueberries
  • 1/2 cup heavy cream
  • 1 large egg
  • 1 tsp vanilla extract
  • Optional: coarse sugar for sprinkling

Instructions

  1. Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
  2. In a large bowl, whisk together flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt.
  3. Cut in the cold butter using a pastry cutter or fingers until mixture resembles coarse crumbs.
  4. Gently fold in blueberries.
  5. In a separate bowl, whisk together cream, egg, and vanilla.
  6. Pour wet ingredients into dry ingredients and stir until just combined.
  7. Turn dough onto a floured surface, shape into a 1-inch thick circle, and cut into 8 wedges.
  8. Place wedges on the prepared baking sheet, brush with extra cream, and sprinkle with coarse sugar if desired.
  9. Bake for 18-22 minutes until golden brown. Cool on a wire rack before serving.

Tips

For best results, use cold ingredients and handle the dough minimally to keep scones tender. Serve warm with clotted cream or jam.

© 2026 Coded Culinary. Recipe last updated: 2025-11-15.
